nodes.title: PASS 1 OUTPUT - Saved Tile Path (disable for Pass 2)
widgets_values: Queue Pass 1 to save the selected tile.

PASS 1 ? SAVE TILES TO DISK

Disk Merge and Final Video Export start disabled. Set ?Current Tile Index? to 0 and queue once. Then increment it and queue once per tile until tile_count ? 1. Keep the same job_name and output folder. The Saved Tile Path output confirms each completed .pt tile.

PASS 2 ? MERGE SAVED TILES

After every tile is saved: set ?PASS 1 OUTPUT ? Saved Tile Path? to Never, set ?PASS 2 ? Disk Merge? to Always, and set ?PASS 2 ? Final Video Export? to Always. Queue once. CPU merge is selected to minimize VRAM use.
